names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 februarie, «Sfânta Muceniță Agata».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Φεβρουαρίου, «Αγία Αγάθη», with the rank word left off.

hymns.text: Mieluşeaua Ta, Iisuse, Agata, strigă cu glas mare: pe Tine, Mirele meu, te iubesc și pe Tine căutându-Te mă chinuiesc și împreună mă răstignesc și împreună mă îngrop cu Botezul Tău; și pătimesc pentru Tine, ca să împărățesc întru Tine; și mor pentru tine, ca să viez pentru Tine; ci, ca o jertfă fără de prihană, primește-mă pe mine ceea ce cu dragoste mă jertfesc Ție. Pentru rugăciunile ei, ca un Milostiv, mântuiește sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Mucenițe Agata, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy lamb Agatha, O Jesus, cries out with a loud voice: Thee, my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking Thee I suffer; I am crucified with Thee and buried with Thee in Thy Baptism; I suffer for Thee that I may reign in Thee; I die for Thee that I may live in Thee. Receive me as an unblemished sacrifice, offered to Thee with love. At her prayers, O Merciful One, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ῥόδον εὔοσμον τῆς παρθενίας, νύμφη ἄφθορος τοῦ Ζωοδότου, ἀνεδέδειξαι Ἀγαθὴ πανεύφημε· τῶν ἀγαθῶν τὴν πηγὴν γὰρ ποθήσασα, μαρτυρικῶς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ διέπρεψας· μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, λιταῖς σου θείαις ἀγάθυνον τοὺς πόθῳ μεγαλύνοντας τοὺς ἄθλους σου.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Αγία Αγάθη, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: A sweet-smelling rose of virginity, an undefiled bride of the Giver of life, you were shown to be, all-praised Agatha; for having longed for the fountain of good things you were distinguished in the world by martyrdom. Glorious martyr, by your divine prayers make good those who magnify your contests with longing.

hymns.text: Στολιζέσθω σήμερον, ἡ Ἐκκλησία, πορφυρίδα ἔνδοξον, καταβαφεῖσαν ἐξ ἁγνῶν, ῥύθρων Ἀγάθης τῆς Μάρτυρος· Χαῖρε, βοῶσα, Κατάνης τό καύχημα.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Αγία Αγάθη, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: Let the Church be clothed today in a glorious purple robe, dyed from the pure streams of Agatha the martyr, crying: rejoice, boast of Catania.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 februarie — «Sfânta Muceniță Agata»

attestations.note: The life closes by saying that the wonder at Catania happened «în luna februarie, în cinci zile, în care sfânta a pătimit», the day on which she suffered. The troparion the site prints for her is the common of one woman martyr.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Αγία Αγάθη»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
